---
title: Species info
---

```{r}

library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

# Read in species info data:

species_info <- 
  here("data", "species_info.rds") %>% 
  read_rds() %>% 
  split(.$alpha_code)

# Custom functions --------------------------------------------------------

my_kable_style <-
  function(.kable) {
    .kable %>% 
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = 
          c(
            "striped",
            "hover",
            "condensed"
          ),
        full_width = FALSE,
        font_size = 28
      )
  }

```

# Species information

<div class="accordion-group" data-open-today="true">

<button class="accordion"> `r species_info$AGOL$common_name` (*`r species_info$AGOL$scientific_name`*)</button>

::: panel

```{r}

species_info$AGOL %>% 
  select(
    "Brood attempts" = brood_attempts,
    "Incubation" = incubation,
    "Nestling" = nestling
  ) %>% 
  kable() %>% 
  my_kable_style()

```
